Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.agdis.label: On the Open Reverend
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.agdis.startdescription: 'This is not a matter for me, I think. The power I serve is not gentle. He has lost his skin, and he accepts the gifts of others' flayings… but there is a crueller Hour at work here. I will withdraw. Thank you, Librarian.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.aladi.label: On the Second Skin
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.aladi.startdescription: 'Echidna, the Ligeian, she who suckles serpents… yes, I am aware that serpents do not generally suckle. I believe now that Abecassis has chosen to drink of what she provides. I do not know if there is anything to be done about that. But thank you, Librarian.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.aladi.label: On the Dappled Rose
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.aladi.startdescription: 'Long ago, you know, there were not so many colours in the world… I suppose life was simpler then. But I prefer the luxury we have of hues. Thank you, Librarian.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.aladi.label: On the Claw and the Clouds
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.aladi.startdescription: 'Whenever the skies coincide, the travelling kinds of the Carapace Cross visit their old home. They are wary - they never stay long. It happens rarely, but it has happened before. Each time, our more excitable peers resolve that they have returned to stay, that everything will change, that the Cross within will manifest. It never does. But I do not take it for granted that it never will. I think it will be necessary for me to cross the ocean...'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.aladi.label: On the Other Horizon
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.aladi.startdescription: 'When Hendrik Dewulf was still a mercenary captain, his company was employed to patrol the Bounds. I suspect that is why the King appointed him lord of this place. I would not say, exactly, that one can travel to Ys from Brancrug… but I believe that Brancrug would be a good place to begin that journey. Thank you, Librarian.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.aladi.label: On the Rising While
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.aladi.startdescription: 'You know, Librarian, that the Hour named Seven Coils was a god-from-stone. She fell to the blades of the Colonel… but one tradition is that she 'drowned in her own blood'. And another tradition has it that her blood is golden… as the Sun is golden. I can almost make sense of it, but only almost... I do not think that I will visit this oracle. I am afraid of what I might learn.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.aladi.label: On the Sandalwood Saint
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.aladi.startdescription: 'Wisest, I think, to burn it. The days of the Cross are long past. It's all very well to be sentimental. But I do not think that we are likely to be friends with those who came before. And, of course, we can be assured of a sweet scent!'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.aladi.label: On the Absent Friend
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.aladi.startdescription: 'Some authorities favour 'Eternity'. Others 'the Cross', but I fear that might irritate her… perhaps it would be safest to resolve that the answer is 'Me'. Thank you, Librarian.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.arthu.label: On the Second Skin
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.arthu.startdescription: 'I am resolved not to fail in this matter. But what will become of Abecassis in the coils of the Labyrinth - that I cannot say.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.arthu.label: On the Forgivable Debt
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.arthu.startdescription: 'Frankly, Librarian, I'm hoping I don't have to shoot anyone. But if I do, I know now what to shoot 'em with.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.arthu.label: On the Particular Mystique
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.arthu.startdescription: 'The Sun's Plan… it is a labyrinth, just as much as the Labyrinth of Lions itself. For almost eighty years I have been guessing at its crossings and turnings. A long time, even with the measures I have taken to keep those years at bay. I am beginning to hope now that I will see the heart of it before I die.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.arthu.label: On the Unfettered Eye
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.arthu.startdescription: 'I am inclined to believe that this might qualify as a fulfilment of the prophecy. I had almost hoped it was not, Librarian. When the world changes, it will change all at once.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.arthu.label: On the Royal Endeavour
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.arthu.startdescription: 'What is happening here - I think it is no more perilous than any line in the Sun's Plan. And it is much grander. We all make our choices - my choice, now, is to be proud of my kin and his part in the work. Thank you, Librarian. I hope that you will keep this matter between us alone.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.arthu.label: On the Threshold Revolution
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.arthu.startdescription: 'My friends in the Bounds have not been altogether honest with me… but neither have they lied, exactly. Thank you, Librarian. I have a great deal to think about.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.arthu.label: On the Absent Friend
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.arthu.startdescription: ''What Is Not Seen?' I had long believed the best answer is 'Light'. But I am no longer certain. Thank you, Librarian. I have some thinking to do.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.arun..label: On the Messenger's Casket
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.arun..startdescription: ''Inevitable as breakfast'… I stand by the maxim. After one sleeps, one eats, or one is eaten. And of course it is pleasant to sleep after eating, and very pleasant to sleep after being eaten. One never knows exactly what will happen in the end, eh, Librarian? Only what has happened before.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.arun..label: On the Dappled Rose
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.arun..startdescription: 'I think, Librarian, we may be approaching a turn in history when flowers seek moths, and not so much the other way around. I'm sorry. It's very hard for me not to speak in riddles. Let me try this. Be very careful when the time comes to stand beneath the tree. The choice is always yours.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.arun..label: On the Forgivable Debt
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.arun..startdescription: 'Sometimes, Librarian, it must be frustrating never to see how these matters come out. But I envy you. Once one is wound in, one is never quite wound out.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.arun..label: On the 'Invisible Opera'
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.arun..startdescription: 'The Magpie would generally deputise a lesser power to arrange a suitable disaster at the Opera. But he has been known to attend the performances himself… and now I have an idea how I might encourage him to do so. Thank you, Librarian. I've been needing a chat with Ferezeref for a very long time indeed.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.arun..label: On the Rising While
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.arun..startdescription: 'I was neither entirely right nor entirely wrong. We know 'now' most during the day, less at night, but most of all at sunset… when the Sun shares his blood with us. If we could share our blood with the Sun at dawn, we would know the most 'now' of all. Good day, Librarian.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.arun..label: On the Friar's Tapestry
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.arun..startdescription: 'Robigo, the Generous with Hosts, the Little Travelling. He's a Name of the Crowned Growth; he's an especial friend of the Haustorium; and if anyone bears the blame for the Ortucchio Incident, it's him. None of these phrases give me any particular pleasure to say. Be of good cheer, Librarian! Once I go out into the world, you may never have to hear any of them ever again.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.azita.label: On the Second Skin
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.azita.startdescription: 'I am armed, I am prepared, I am resolved. This part of the game gives me no pleasure at all. But I did not expect Eternity ever to be gentle. I made my choice, and so did Abecassis. Goodbye, Librarian.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.azita.label: On the Forgivable Debt
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.azita.startdescription: 'Thank you, Librarian. Rest assured: I do not shed blood unless I must. A stern lecture may suffice. But the lecture must be very stern indeed.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.azita.label: On the Claw and the Clouds
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.azita.startdescription: 'The Cross, is it? After all these years, I find something else that Mehrad and I do not have in common. It is almost romantic! And all thanks to you, Librarian.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.azita.label: On 'Apollo and Marsyas'
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.azita.startdescription: 'Just so. Mehrad will love this! Thank you.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.azita.label: On the Unfinished Lark
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.azita.startdescription: 'I think, Librarian, that Zidane had been eavesdropping at the keyholes of heaven. At least the motive is grander than artistic jealousy. But I do not think it will be practical to avenge him.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.azita.label: On the Threshold Revolution
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.azita.startdescription: 'Yes; I think that I have found an acceptable substitute. I anticipate an excellent profit. Let me offer you a cut…'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.azita.label: On the Absent Friend
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.azita.startdescription: 'Most helpful, Librarian. Thank you for indulging our silly games.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.chaim.label: On the Second Skin
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.chaim.startdescription: 'Wish me luck, Librarian. But not too much. This hunt, this time - perhaps I would prefer it to fail.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.chaim.label: On the Dappled Rose
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.chaim.startdescription: 'I think that this will be enough. I leave now for Miah. Thank you.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.chaim.label: On the Forgivable Debt
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.chaim.startdescription: 'I have what I need. (Except that I will also need a bath.) Thank you.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.chaim.label: On the Other Horizon
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.chaim.startdescription: 'Hints and fireside tales only. But enough to direct my search. I will find nothing. But I do not like to leave a task half-finished.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.chaim.label: On the Threshold Revolution
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.chaim.startdescription: 'Useful. Thank you, Librarian. This is for your trouble.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.chaim.label: On the Absent Friend
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.chaim.startdescription: 'Thank you. I know now how to protect myself. As long as I don't get too close.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.chaim.label: On the Absent Friend
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.chaim.startdescription: 'Thank you. I know now how to appease her. As long as I show sufficient respect.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.conni.label: On the Messenger's Casket
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.conni.startdescription: 'Something that carries fire in darkness; something that can leave a place it never entered; something that no-one will let alone. That sounds like a Name of the Chandler. These things shouldn't even exist - and now, this year, I've heard of two at least… keep this between us, Librarian. Thank you.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.conni.label: On the Forgivable Debt
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.conni.startdescription: 'Librarian... this trade of years. It's the Madrugad who keeps the tally, and the Madrugad who is invoked when Reckoners make the trade. I think, just possibly, the stupidest Reckoner in the history of stupidity has turned a profit by cheating the Madrugad. I don't know who's going to regret that most. I'd better get to Kaunas.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.conni.label: On the Claw and the Clouds
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.conni.startdescription: 'I understand where they're going, even if I don't know why. I'd like to make a field trip… but I'm not certain I want to travel by aeroplane, not while this is going on. You know, if I were you, I wouldn't take any beach walks at sunset, not until all this settles down. Just in case.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.conni.label: On 'Apollo and Marsyas'
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.conni.startdescription: ' I'll talk to our cousins of the Duties in Paris. Perhaps it's not as bad as I'd thought…'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.conni.label: On the Unfinished Lark
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.conni.startdescription: 'Technically speaking, you know, he wasn't murdered. Only a human being can commit murder. The legal situation is much the same as if Zidane had been struck by lightning. In another country entirely. Lucky the Bureau doesn't worry about technicalities, isn't it?'
